The point $\left({\text{x}}_{1} , {\text{y}}_{1}\right)$ is $\left(- 1, 1\right),$ therefore, pependicular distance from $\left(- 1, 1\right)$ to the line $12\text{x} - 5\text{y} + 82 = 0$ is
